test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the meaning of the given idiom.

cut from the same cloth

options.text: to be of a similar nature
to come from the same source

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"cut from the same cloth"** means to be of a similar nature or to share similar characteristics. (समान प्रकृति का होना)

 
 
• **Example:** The two brothers are ***cut from the same cloth***; both are hardworking and honest.
 
 
 
• **"To be of a similar nature"** implies that two or more entities share similar traits or qualities. (समान प्रकृति का होना)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite their different backgrounds, the two friends*** are of a similar nature***, both being kind and considerate.
 
 

Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is '**to be of a similar nature**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Belong to the same family** (एक ही परिवार से संबंधित होना): To be members of the same family.

 
 
• **Example:** They** belong to the same family,** which explains their similar looks.
 
 
 
• **To come from the same source** (एक ही स्रोत से आना): To originate from the same place or origin.
 
 
• **Example:** The rumors **come from the same source,** which is why they sound so similar.
 
 
 
• **To share resources** (संसाधनों को साझा करना): To use the same resources or assets.
 
 
• **Example:** The two departments need to** share resources** to complete the project efficiently.
 
 

92:Td03,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
